text:
Please stop using the same old apology pattern. This isn't just a communication error; it concerns dental treatment, which requires high precision and responsibility.

A clinic that advertises its standards should have a better verification system. Repeated mistakes undermine patient confidence.

Last time, during a filling, one piece of the appliance was removed, and it wasn't fully reattached. This time, it hasn't been corrected, even though I'm scheduled to have my braces removed next month.

Furthermore, I was scheduled for a scaling appointment, supposedly before braces removal, but they didn't check that I had just had one done about two months ago. Also, I recently had a filling done, yet they recommended an X-ray for cavities. This highlights the need for thorough internal coordination.

Even something as small as the dentist providing rubber bands, but the counter staff charged 100 baht, further highlights the need for improved internal communication.

Parents entrust their dental health to this clinic; they shouldn't have to constantly monitor and verify mistakes themselves.

restaurant_name: Melon Dental Clinic-จัดฟัน ทำฟัน
text:
We were probably a difficult case not suitable for this clinic. We spent 9 months getting adjustments here. If we had decided from the beginning, during the treatment plan, we wouldn't have wasted so much time. We only realized this after 9 months of adjustments. After 9 months, considering our teeth after 9 adjustments, we realized that the problems we wanted to solve couldn't be resolved here based on the treatment plan and the nature of our teeth. It would only be possible to straighten the teeth. This clinic might be more suitable and better for less difficult cases (congratulations to those who had successful treatments and had their problems addressed). After realizing this, we decided to transfer our case elsewhere because we knew for sure that even if we completed the treatment, the problems wouldn't be solved. We transferred our case, and everything became clearer and more precise.
- Complete and clear details were provided.
- Problems and how they could or couldn't be solved were clearly explained, with personalized guidance for each patient.
- X-rays were easy, the equipment was modern, and the images were clear, eliminating the need for repeated shots.
- At each adjustment session, the doctor explained the details of the adjustments and what was being done, and its purpose.
- Details of what needed to be done at subsequent appointments were always provided.

We are writing this review simply to warn those with more complex dental cases who are considering starting orthodontic treatment, especially if some things aren't clear. If you're unsure about the solution for your dental problems from the start, try consulting with several different clinics. Find the one that best suits your needs. There's definitely a place that can provide the right solution. Because if you choose orthodontics and the problems aren't resolved, the biggest regret is the wasted time, the expense, and the fact that maintaining your teeth during orthodontic treatment isn't easy. You'll need various products and tools for cleaning, and the process of preventing cavities during treatment takes a long time. The cleaning and care process is much more difficult than for normal teeth.
